text:
Table: battery_wear_events

Description:
Time-series log of battery wear/degradation events recorded per vehicle and trip. Each row captures a single battery event with nominal and under-load voltage readings, state-of-health percentage, idle time, and a severity multiplier used to derive the wear_units contributed to the vehicle's battery component health.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- startup_cycle: int (nullable)
- event_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- v_nominal: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- v_under_load: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- soh_percent: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- idle_minutes: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- severity_multi: decimal(4,2) (nullable)
- wear_units: decimal(8,2) (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
battery wear, battery health, state of health, SOH, voltage, startup cycle, idle time, component degradation, telemetry event

Table: brake_wear_events

Description:
Time-series log of brake wear events recorded per vehicle and trip. Each row captures a braking event with speed, gross vehicle weight, road slope, longitudinal acceleration and braking energy in joules, used to derive the wear_units contributed to the vehicle's brake component health.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- brake_count: int (nullable)
- event_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- speed_kmh: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- gvw_kg: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- gps_slope: decimal(6,3) (nullable)
- accel_x: decimal(6,4) (nullable)
- energy_joules: decimal(14,2) (nullable)
- severity_multi: decimal(4,2) (nullable)
- wear_units: decimal(8,2) (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
brake wear, braking event, energy joules, gross vehicle weight, GVW, road slope, deceleration, component degradation, telemetry event

Table: clutch_wear_events

Description:
Time-series log of clutch wear events recorded per vehicle and trip. Each row captures engine RPM, speed, slip ratio, torque, gross vehicle weight and road slope at the moment of the event, used to derive the wear_units contributed to the vehicle's clutch component health.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- event_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- rpm: int (nullable)
- speed_kmh: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- slip_ratio: decimal(8,4) (nullable)
- torque_nm: decimal(7,2) (nullable)
- gvw_kg: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- gps_slope: decimal(6,3) (nullable)
- severity_multi: decimal(4,2) (nullable)
- wear_units: decimal(8,2) (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
clutch wear, slip ratio, torque, RPM, gross vehicle weight, GVW, road slope, component degradation, telemetry event

Table: component_base_life

Description:
Reference table storing the configured base/expected life (in wear units) for each trackable component (e.g. battery, brake, clutch, engine, tire) on a given vehicle. There is one row per vehicle-component combination (enforced by a unique constraint on vehicle_id and component), and it serves as the baseline that accumulated wear is compared against in component_wear_state.

Columns:
- id: uniqueidentifier (PK)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- component: nvarchar(20)
- base_life: decimal(12,2)
- wear_unit_type: nvarchar(30) (nullable)
- created_at: datetime2(7)

Relationships:
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
base life, component lifespan, wear unit type, baseline, maintenance threshold, configuration, vehicle component

Table: component_wear_state

Description:
Current wear state of each component on each vehicle, tracking accumulated_wear against base_life. There is one row per vehicle-component combination (enforced by a unique constraint on vehicle_id and component). The rul column is a computed/persisted column equal to base_life minus accumulated_wear (floored at 0), representing remaining useful life. The health_score column is a computed/persisted column equal to rul as a percentage of base_life, clamped between 0 and 100. These two columns are pre-calculated by the database and should be read directly rather than recomputed.

Columns:
- id: uniqueidentifier (PK)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- component: nvarchar(20)
- accumulated_wear: decimal(14,4)
- base_life: decimal(14,4)
- rul: decimal (computed, persisted)
- health_score: decimal (computed, persisted)
- last_updated: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
wear state, remaining useful life, RUL, health score, accumulated wear, component health, predictive maintenance

Table: drivers

Description:
Master list of drivers, storing each driver's identifier, display name and active status.

Columns:
- driver_id: nvarchar(20) (PK)
- driver_name: nvarchar(100)
- is_active: bit
- created_at: datetime2(7)

Relationships:
- None

Keywords:
driver master, driver profile, driver name, active driver

Table: engine_wear_events

Description:
Time-series log of engine wear/health events recorded per vehicle and trip. Each row captures RPM, coolant temperature, torque, engine load, fuel rate, idle time, oil pressure, an overheat flag, event type, and any diagnostic trouble codes (DTC), used to derive the wear_units contributed to the vehicle's engine component health.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- rpm: int (nullable)
- coolant_temp: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- torque_nm: decimal(7,2) (nullable)
- engine_load: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- fuel_rate: decimal(7,3) (nullable)
- idle_minutes: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- oil_pressure: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- overheat: bit (nullable)
- event_type: nvarchar(30) (nullable)
- severity_multi: decimal(4,2) (nullable)
- wear_units: decimal(10,4) (nullable)
- dtc_codes: nvarchar(500) (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
engine wear, overheat, coolant temperature, oil pressure, DTC codes, diagnostic trouble codes, engine load, fuel rate, component degradation

Table: fmc_raw_packets

Description:
Raw telemetry packets received from the fleet-tracking device (FMC) for a given trip, vehicle and driver. Each row is a single device transmission capturing ignition state, speed, fuel level and GPS coordinates at a point in time. This table is the upstream source feed referenced by journey_fuel_logs1 via raw_packet_id.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- trip_id: nvarchar(20)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- driver_id: nvarchar(20)
- event_time: datetime2(7)
- ignition: bit
- speed_kmh: decimal(10,2)
- fuel_level_liters: decimal(10,2)
- gps_lat: decimal(10,6)
- gps_lng: decimal(10,6)
- created_at: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- driver_id → drivers.driver_id
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
raw telemetry packet, FMC device, GPS coordinates, ignition status, fuel level, tracking device feed

Table: journey_fuel_logs

Description:
Per-trip fuel monitoring log capturing fuel level, refuel detection, fuel-theft detection and receipt verification alongside ignition, speed and GPS position. This is a legacy/alternate fuel-log table: vehicle_id and driver_id are stored as free-text codes (not typed identifiers) and the flag columns (ignition, is_refuel, is_fuel_theft, receipt_uploaded) are stored as tinyint rather than bit. No foreign key constraints are defined on this table, so it is not formally linked to vehicles, drivers or journeys even though the trip_id/vehicle_id/driver_id values correspond to those tables conceptually.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- trip_id: nvarchar(20)
- vehicle_id: nvarchar(50)
- driver_id: nvarchar(10)
- event_time: datetime2(7)
- ignition: tinyint
- speed_kmh: decimal(6,2)
- fuel_level_liters: decimal(10,2)
- fuel_diff_liters: decimal(10,2)
- is_refuel: tinyint
- refuel_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- is_fuel_theft: tinyint
- theft_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- theft_type: nvarchar(30) (nullable)
- receipt_uploaded: tinyint
- receipt_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- gps_lat: decimal(10,6)
- gps_lng: decimal(10,6)

Relationships:
- None

Keywords:
fuel log, refuel, fuel theft, receipt verification, fuel level, GPS, legacy fuel table

Table: journey_fuel_logs1

Description:
Fuel-difference, refuel and fuel-theft analysis derived from a specific raw telemetry packet in fmc_raw_packets, including receipt verification for that packet. This is the newer fuel-log table that links to fmc_raw_packets via raw_packet_id instead of storing trip/vehicle/driver codes directly.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- raw_packet_id: bigint
- fuel_diff_liters: decimal(10,2)
- is_refuel: bit
- refuel_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- is_fuel_theft: bit
- theft_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- theft_type: nvarchar(100) (nullable)
- receipt_uploaded: bit
- receipt_amount_liters: decimal(10,2)
- created_at: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- raw_packet_id → fmc_raw_packets.id

Keywords:
fuel log, refuel, fuel theft, receipt verification, raw packet, fuel difference

Table: journey_scores

Description:
Per-trip driver scoring results. Compares actual vs expected fuel usage for the trip to flag possible fuel theft, and stores an overall driver_score (and a rule-based variant, driver_score_rule) for that trip.

Columns:
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (PK)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- driver_id: nvarchar(20)
- actual_fuel_used_L: float (nullable)
- expected_fuel_L: float (nullable)
- theft_occurred: nvarchar(10) (nullable)
- theft_type: nvarchar(50) (nullable)
- theft_amount_L: float (nullable)
- driver_score: float (nullable)
- created_at: datetime2(7) (nullable)
- driver_score_rule: decimal(5,2) (nullable)

Relationships:
- driver_id → drivers.driver_id
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
driver score, fuel theft detection, expected fuel, actual fuel, trip scoring, scorecard

Table: journeys

Description:
Master record of each vehicle trip/journey. Stores trip timing (start/end), route and location, distance and odometer readings, speed and idle-time statistics, driving-behavior event counts (acceleration, braking, cornering, over-speeding, stops), engine telemetry averages, and detailed fuel-level/fuel-efficiency calculations (including the P86 and P87 fuel measurement fields). This is the central fact table for trips: it is referenced by trip_id from battery_wear_events, brake_wear_events, clutch_wear_events, engine_wear_events, harsh_events, raw_telemetry, tire_wear_events, fmc_raw_packets and journey_scores.

Columns:
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (PK)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- driver_id: nvarchar(20)
- route_type: nvarchar(50) (nullable)
- start_location: nvarchar(255) (nullable)
- end_location: nvarchar(255) (nullable)
- trip_start: datetime2(7) (nullable)
- trip_end: datetime2(7) (nullable)
- trip_duration_min: float (nullable)
- engine_total_hours: float (nullable)
- total_odometer: float (nullable)
- distance_km: float (nullable)
- load_pct: float (nullable)
- temp_celsius: float (nullable)
- hour_of_day: int (nullable)
- day_of_week: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- avg_speed_kmh: float (nullable)
- max_speed_kmh: float (nullable)
- idle_time_min: float (nullable)
- num_stops: int (nullable)
- accel_events: int (nullable)
- brake_events: int (nullable)
- over_speed_count: int (nullable)
- cornering_events: int (nullable)
- avg_engine_rpm: float (nullable)
- avg_engine_load_pct: float (nullable)
- avg_fuel_rate_Lhr: float (nullable)
- P86_fuel_start_L: float (nullable)
- P86_fuel_end_L: float (nullable)
- P86_trip_diff_L: float (nullable)
- P87_fuel_start_pct: float (nullable)
- P87_fuel_end_pct: float (nullable)
- P87_fuel_start_L: float (nullable)
- P87_fuel_end_L: float (nullable)
- fuel_efficiency_kmpl: float (nullable)
- refuel_L: float (nullable)
- created_at: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- driver_id → drivers.driver_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
trip, journey, route, distance, odometer, idle time, driving behavior, fuel efficiency, fleet trip summary

Table: maintenance_alerts

Description:
Maintenance alerts raised when a vehicle component's remaining useful life or health score crosses an alerting threshold. Records the RUL and health score at the moment of the alert, the alert severity level, a message, and whether/when the alert was acknowledged.

Columns:
- id: uniqueidentifier (PK)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- component: nvarchar(20)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- rul_at_alert: decimal(14,4) (nullable)
- health_at_alert: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- alert_level: nvarchar(10) (nullable)
- message: nvarchar(500) (nullable)
- acknowledged: bit (nullable)
- ack_at: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
maintenance alert, health score, RUL, acknowledgement, alert level, predictive maintenance notification

Table: raw_telemetry

Description:
High-frequency raw telemetry feed per vehicle and trip, capturing onboard sensor/OBD readings: engine (RPM, load, coolant temp, torque, oil pressure, engine hours), fuel (rate, used, level), motion (speed, acceleration on three axes, road slope, odometer), GPS position (latitude/longitude), battery voltage, ignition state, and harsh-event/overspeeding flags. This is the primary granular data source feeding the wear-event and trip-summary calculations.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- speed: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- rpm: int (nullable)
- engine_load: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- coolant_temp: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- fuel_rate: decimal(7,3) (nullable)
- fuel_used: decimal(10,3) (nullable)
- fuel_level: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- oil_pressure: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- engine_torque: decimal(7,2) (nullable)
- engine_hours: decimal(10,2) (nullable)
- idle_time: decimal(10,2) (nullable)
- brake_pedal: bit (nullable)
- gvw: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- odometer: decimal(12,3) (nullable)
- dtc_codes: nvarchar(500) (nullable)
- accel_x: decimal(6,4) (nullable)
- accel_y: decimal(6,4) (nullable)
- accel_z: decimal(6,4) (nullable)
- gps_slope: decimal(6,3) (nullable)
- latitude: decimal(10,7) (nullable)
- longitude: decimal(10,7) (nullable)
- battery_voltage: decimal(5,2) (nullable)
- ignition: bit (nullable)
- harsh_brake: bit (nullable)
- harsh_accel: bit (nullable)
- harsh_corner: bit (nullable)
- overspeeding: bit (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
raw telemetry, OBD, GPS coordinates, latitude longitude, harsh driving flags, fuel rate, engine sensor data, gross vehicle weight

Table: replay_tracker

Description:
Single-row control/checkpoint table used by the system to track the timestamp up to which historical data has already been replayed or processed.

Columns:
- id: int (PK)
- last_historical_time: datetime2(7) (nullable)

Relationships:
- None

Keywords:
replay tracker, processing checkpoint, historical data cursor, system state

Table: tire_profiles

Description:
Reference table of tire-type wear coefficients used by the tire wear-life model. One row per tire_type, defining the base kilometre life and four model coefficients (coeff_a-d) used to calculate tire wear severity for vehicles of that tire type.

Columns:
- id: uniqueidentifier (PK)
- tire_type: nvarchar(50) (unique)
- base_km: int
- coeff_a: decimal(8,4)
- coeff_b: decimal(8,4)
- coeff_c: decimal(8,4)
- coeff_d: decimal(8,4)

Relationships:
- None

Keywords:
tire profile, tire type, wear coefficient, base kilometers, tire life model

Table: tire_wear_events

Description:
Time-series log of tire wear events recorded per vehicle and trip. Each row captures distance covered, speed, lateral G-force, gross vehicle weight and vibration (RMS) for the event, used to derive the wear_units contributed to the vehicle's tire component health.

Columns:
- id: bigint (PK, identity)
- vehicle_id: uniqueidentifier
- trip_id: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- ts: datetime2(7)
- distance_km: decimal(10,3) (nullable)
- speed_kmh: decimal(6,2) (nullable)
- lateral_g: decimal(6,4) (nullable)
- gvw_kg: decimal(8,2) (nullable)
- vibration_rms: decimal(8,4) (nullable)
- event_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- severity_multi: decimal(4,2) (nullable)
- wear_units: decimal(10,4) (nullable)

Relationships:
- trip_id → journeys.trip_id
- vehicle_id → vehicles.id

Keywords:
tire wear, vibration, lateral G-force, gross vehicle weight, GVW, distance, component degradation

Table: vehicles

Description:
Master record of each vehicle in the fleet: registration number, display name, vehicle type, make/model, fuel type, engine capacity, clutch type, tire type and battery rating, plus active status. This is the parent/reference table for the fleet and is referenced by vehicle_id from nearly every telemetry, wear-event, journey, score and alert table.

Columns:
- id: uniqueidentifier (PK)
- reg_no: nvarchar(50) (unique)
- vehicle_name: nvarchar(100) (nullable)
- vehicle_type: nvarchar(100) (nullable)
- make: nvarchar(50) (nullable)
- model: nvarchar(50) (nullable)
- fuel_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- engine_cc: int (nullable)
- clutch_type: nvarchar(20) (nullable)
- tire_type: nvarchar(50) (nullable)
- battery_ah: int (nullable)
- is_active: bit
- created_at: datetime2(7)

Relationships:
- None

Keywords:
vehicle master, fleet vehicle, registration number, make model, fuel type, engine capacity, vehicle profile
